question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 at 6.5% per annum rate of interest for the period from 13 February 2023 to 27 April 2023
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time from 13 Feb to 27 Apr = 15 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 27 (Apr) = 73 days.

Time in years = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 year.

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 6.5 × 1) ÷ (100 × 5)

⇒ SI = 20 × 1.3 = ₹26

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate of Interest (R) = 6.5% p.a.

Time Period = From 13 February 2023 to 27 April 2023

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05e4d75676da648f3eb90d56b2fcf4997e9b9c75693e5d2b990d452d711ae032.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The year 2023 is an ordinary year, so February has 28 days.

⇒ Days left in February = 28 − 13 = 15 days

⇒ Days in March = 31 days

⇒ Days in April = 27 days

⇒ Total Days (T) = 15 + 31 + 27 = 73 days

⇒ Converting time into years, T = 73 ÷ 365 = 1/5 years

⇒ SI = (2000 × 6.5 × 1/5) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = (2000 × 6.5) ÷ 500

⇒ SI = 4 × 6.5

⇒ SI = 26

**∴ The correct answer is ₹26.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Amount Formula

The total amount at the end of the term is the sum of the initial Principal and the Simple Interest earned: Amount = P + SI.

Day Calculation Rule

When calculating interest for a specific period of days, typically either the depositing date or the withdrawal date is counted, but not both.

Rule of 72

It is a quick shortcut to estimate the number of years required to double your invested money at a given annual fixed rate. (Years ≈ 72 ÷ Rate).
